      "band": "Unranked",

      "rationale": "Interface adjustments in src/interfaces/wallet.h serve the wallet feature rather than IPC mechanics, which the category explicitly excludes."
    },
    {
      "name": "rpc",
      "member": true,
      "evidence": "Adds the new node RPC scantxforsilentpayments in src/rpc/output_script.cpp and updates rawtransaction utilities.",
      "band": "P3",
      "score": 0.35,
      "reason_tag": "new feature",
      "rationale": "Adds the scantxforsilentpayments RPC to allow callers to inspect transactions for Silent Payment outputs. It extends RPC capabilities for downstream indexers and tooling without modifying core RPC server infrastructure."
    },
    {
      "name": "tests",
      "member": false,
      "evidence": "Test changes in functional and bench suites test the wallet Silent Payments sending implementation specifically rather than test framework machinery.",
      "band": "Unranked",
      "score": 0,
      "reason_tag": "test coverage",
      "rationale": "Category covers test infrastructure rather than domain-specific test suites, which belong to the wallet area."
    },
    {
      "name": "utils",
      "member": false,
      "evidence": "Changes in src/common/paymentdestination.* and src/common/bip352.* implement Silent Payment domain models and key derivation rather than node-wide shared utilities.",
      "band": "Unranked",
      "score": 0,
      "reason_tag": "new feature",
      "rationale": "PaymentDestination abstractions and BIP 352 helpers in src/common are specific to wallet and transaction creation logic rather than general shared utility primitives."
    },
    {
      "name": "wallet",
      "member": true,
      "evidence": "Extensively modifies wallet spending, coin selection, fee bumping, and database logic across src/wallet/spend.cpp, src/wallet/feebumper.cpp, and src/wallet/walletdb.cpp.",
      "band": "P2",
      "score": 0.72,
      "reason_tag": "new feature",
      "rationale": "Enables sending transactions to BIP 352 Silent Payment addresses and fee-bumping them via RBF. PR description notes this is a core component of BIP 352 integration tracked in issue #28536, delivering significant user-facing privacy improvements to prevent address reuse."
    }
  ],
